subject: Walkling Court Redevelopment and Section 106 Review
overview: The commission determined 37 Locust Street was not significant and reviewed redevelopment plans for Walkling Court, including the Section 106 review process and archaeological considerations. Members also discussed streamlining demolition delay procedures and received legal confirmation on the enforceability of the commission's bylaws.

items.title: 37 Locust Street Significance Determination
items.summary: Determined the property is not significant because it lacks architectural distinction, allowing the applicant to proceed with demolition.

items.title: 23 Winter Street Application
items.summary: Accepted the demolition application for review and authorized $500 to prepare an MHC Form B historical inventory.

items.title: 280 Mystic Avenue Planned Development District
items.summary: Circulated a planned development district application from the planning department for commissioner review and comment.

items.title: Walkling Court Redevelopment
items.summary: Approved up to $2,000 for an historical area form and discussed the Section 106 review process for the demolition and replacement of the housing development. The commission highlighted concerns regarding archaeological resources associated with the Middlesex Canal and proximity to native sites near the river.

items.title: Historical Commission Bylaw Enforceability
items.summary: Reported that legal counsel confirmed the commission's bylaws and approved plans are fully enforceable by the building inspector.

items.title: Ongoing Demolition Delay Updates
items.summary: Discussed design refinements for 31 South Street and a potential restoration plan for the barn at 91 Winchester Street to avoid total demolition.

items.title: Demolition Review Process Streamlining
items.summary: Discussed a proposal to grant automatic significance to buildings constructed before 1900 and authorizing staff to initiate inventory forms to expedite the review timeline.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Projects
items.summary: Announced the completion of Grove Street wall restorations and discussed a proposed $5,000 grant application for a memorial at the Brooks Estate archaeological site.

items.title: Neighborhood Historical Surveys
items.summary: Confirmed the completion of the Brickyards survey and announced that survey work is beginning in the Fulton Heights neighborhood.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes from the May 8, 2023, regular meeting and a subsequent special meeting.
